Maintain the same character scale in the two outputs while folding the airborne silhouette to fit; crisp original pixel-art style, no text, no background, no ground, no effects, no extra characters. One held endpoint pose per input, two independent directional views of the SAME airborne pose, not an animation or sprite sheet.
